# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **don't open a public issue** for security problems.

Report them privately through GitHub: go to the [Security tab](https://github.com/franc3s/featured-post-rotator/security) and choose **Report a vulnerability**. Include the affected version, the steps to reproduce and the impact you expect.

You'll get a reply as soon as possible. Once a fix is released, the report can be made public, with credit if you want it.
